verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only importing into the Consensus Library from Zotero, BibTeX, PDF, or RIS, plus a JSON REST API/MCP surface. Import is the opposite direction from export, and the API is a developer building block, not an export feature. Nothing shows exporting results to documents, spreadsheets, or reference-manager files.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can export results to common formats, including documents, spreadsheets, and reference-manager files
